headline: Your site says "Call Now for 24/7 Welding Solutions", but your Google card shows you open 7 AM to 5 PM.
summary: TNT Welding is Peter Tarantino's mobile welding and fabrication outfit in Alpine, licensed C60 (#1113061), AWS certified, and insured. Your Google card is up as TNT Mobile Welding INC. with your phone, your website, and photos. The leftover is hours: when we checked, the card showed open 7 AM to 5 PM with "Closes 5 PM", while your site leads with "Call Now for 24/7 Welding Solutions" and "24-Hour Mobile Welding San Diego". Someone with an evening emergency who checks Google first may think you are closed.

signals.note: Searching TNT Welding Alpine CA on Google Maps opens your card, TNT Mobile Welding INC., listed as a Welder. Searching your phone number opens the same card.
The card shows (619) 402-0120, the same number on your site and your Nextdoor page.
When we checked, the card showed open 7 AM to 5 PM with "Closes 5 PM". Your site says "Call Now for 24/7 Welding Solutions".
signals.next: If you take emergency calls around the clock, set the card to open 24 hours, or add a note on the card that emergency calls are answered after hours.

signals.note: The card has photos, and your site shows project shots and your Instagram feed.
signals.next: Add a few recent gate and handrail jobs to the card now and then.

signals.note: tntwfm.com is live with your license number, services, and phone. The Google Maps icon in the footer points to an older listing, TNT Mobile welding-Fabricating & Machining, which now opens an empty map instead of your current card.
signals.next: Point the footer icon at your current TNT Mobile Welding INC. card.

signals.note: The business shows up as TNT Welding on Nextdoor, TNTWFM on your site, and TNT Mobile Welding INC. on Google. Nextdoor lists kelly@tntwfm.com, which your site does not print; the site has a phone and a contact form.
signals.next: Pick one name to lead with, and add your inbox to the site if you want email.
